story.festival_harvest.name: Harvest festival
story.festival_harvest.desc: A harvest-festival challenge: bring in sixty pumpkins while the festival is on.
story.festival_harvest.ch.c1.sum: Pumpkins grow around you during the harvest festivals. Harvest sixty of them.
story.festival_harvest.r1.start: A harvest festival is on! Pumpkins are growing in the fields around you — orange, yellow, green, even white ones. Harvest sixty and I have a present for your base.
story.festival_harvest.graduated: A harvest to be proud of. Here: carved pumpkin lanterns and a few lanterns for your door.
story.festival_harvest.d1.start: Harvest sixty pumpkins. Any colour counts — toxic ones too, the detoxifier washes them.
story.festival_harvest.d1.done: Sixty pumpkins! The harvest is in.
